description: Create The Forest Season Resort as the Home_Property of the Mussoorie cluster, GENERATE a realistic multi-platform review dataset FILE for it (plus refreshed competitor data), and run that file through the REAL ingestion/collection pipeline so the whole dashboard tells a coherent story centered on the resort. This is the honest 'scraping and all': the generated dataset is fed through the actual Review_Collector -> parse -> language/transliterate -> sentiment/aspect -> normaliser -> market model -> changepoint code path (NOT illegal live scraping, which the spec gates behind robots.txt+terms and which has no free credential-less path). First confirm the green baseline (236 pytest, 14 vitest, lint, build). Independent of FEAT-002/003 at the code level but they build on its data.
steps: BASELINE: run `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest -q` (expect 236 pass) and `cd frontend && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build` (expect 14 vitest pass, 21 routes). Record the baseline counts before any change.

Add The Forest Season Resort to the sample cluster in backend/app/seed/sample_reviews.py: add PropertySpec('mus-forestseason', 'The Forest Season Resort') as the FIRST entry in PROPERTIES so it is the cluster's home property. Keep the existing 6 competitor properties. Keep CLUSTER_NAME; optionally note the resort is in Mussoorie, Uttarakhand in the module docstring.

GENERATE the review dataset for The Forest Season Resort programmatically rather than hand-writing 1 review each: add a deterministic generator (seeded with a fixed seed for reproducibility) in sample_reviews.py (or a new module imported by it, e.g. backend/app/seed/forest_season_reviews.py) that produces a realistic set of RawSeedReview records for 'mus-forestseason' spread across ALL 5 platforms (Google, MakeMyTrip, Booking.com, TripAdvisor, Agoda using the existing _URL_PATTERN and native rating scales - Booking/Agoda /10, others /5), dated across ~18 months, mixing English + Hinglish (romanised Hindi) + Devanagari text with aspect-rich, code-switched content that exercises sentiment/aspect/changepoint/decomposition (reuse vocabulary styled after _QUOTES in analytics_dataset.py). Aim for roughly 40-80 reviews for the resort (enough to populate counts and read models; keep well under the 10000 upload cap). Include a few records with has_source_url=False to exercise the 'source URL unavailable' path. Keep author display names synthetic; they are pseudonymised via the existing pseudonymise_reviewer so no raw PII is stored.

Wire the generated resort reviews into build_raw_records()/build_review_records() so the existing seed path (MarketRadarService._seed -> collector.store, warmed by warm.py/seed_all) ingests them through the REAL ReviewParser + enrich() pipeline. Confirm property_platform_counts() and reviews_for('mus-forestseason') return the generated data.

RE-CENTER the Deep analytics on the resort: change HOME_PROPERTY_ID in backend/app/services/market_radar/analytics_dataset.py from 'mus-pineview' to 'mus-forestseason' (this propagates to changepoints, what_if, playbook, impact, briefing, intervention_store, guest_compass, analytics_service via import). Ensure analytics_dataset's synthetic MentionObservation generator includes 'mus-forestseason' with per-property offsets, a clear negative trend/changepoint on one resort aspect (for BOCPD + Time Machine), so the resort shows a coherent story. Keep LEADER_PROPERTY_ID a competitor (e.g. mus-cloudvalley). Update the hardcoded intervention dates in time_machine.py (currently anchored to 'mus-pineview') to 'mus-forestseason' so Time Machine interventions attach to the resort.

RE-CENTER In-Stay Sentinel on the resort: in backend/app/seed/sentinel_seed.py set HOME_PROPERTY_ID='mus-forestseason' and HOME_PROPERTY_NAME='The Forest Season Resort' so Stays, SOPs, Checkout Shield board and complaints are populated for the resort.

RE-CENTER Concierge + Guest Compass on the resort: in backend/app/services/concierge/service.py replace the hardcoded 'mus-pineview' property_id defaults (~lines 155,185) with 'mus-forestseason' and make the seeded Property_Facts topical to The Forest Season Resort (check-in/out, wifi, breakfast, pet policy, parking etc.). Confirm guest_compass/service.py picks up the new HOME_PROPERTY_ID import.

Verify Destination Lens: in backend/app/services/destination_lens/service.py the seeded destination mentions reference 'mus-pineview'/'Pine View Inn'; add/relabel at least some to 'mus-forestseason'/'The Forest Season Resort' so the heatmap evidence can cite the resort (keep other properties for a realistic multi-property destination view).

Regenerate checked-in artifacts: run `cd backend && uv run python scripts/build_dataset.py` to rewrite data/sample_reviews/mussoorie_reviews.json and refresh the auto-generated COUNTS block in data/datasheet.md so counts match the new resort + generated reviews. Update the prose/honesty note in data/datasheet.md to describe the new resort, the ~18-month date span, the generated (synthetic/representative) nature, and that live platform scraping requires each platform's official API/permission (ties to responsible-collection Req 2). If build_dataset.py needs small changes to include the resort, make them.

DEMONSTRATE the real ingestion/collection path explicitly (the 'scraping and all'): verify that the generated dataset can also be ingested via the upload endpoint POST /market-radar/collection/upload. Add a backend test that posts the generated resort reviews (as JSON) through TestClient to that endpoint for a platform and asserts the job status + new_count reflect the parsed/deduped records, proving the file flows through the live collector. Keep/showcase responsible.py (robots.txt-respecting module) as the scrape-mode mechanism in docs but drive the demo via sample/upload ingestion.

Add/extend backend tests under backend/tests/: (a) the resort appears in review-counts with reviews on all 5 platforms and a sensible total; (b) HOME_PROPERTY_ID is 'mus-forestseason' and analytics endpoints (playbook, what-if, changepoints, decomposition, time-machine) return the resort as home with non-empty data; (c) sentinel board/metrics are populated for the resort; (d) the dataset-generator is deterministic (same seed -> same records) and the datasheet counts match the generated file (there is likely an existing count-match test to update). Fix any existing tests that hardcoded 'mus-pineview'/'Pine View Inn' expectations.

VERIFY in-process: run `cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed` then a TestClient(app) heredoc hitting /health, /market-radar/review-counts (resort present with per-platform counts), /sentinel/board, /sentinel/metrics, /destination/heatmap, /concierge/facts, /market-radar/analytics/playbook, /market-radar/analytics/what-if/Google - all HTTP 200 with resort-populated data. Then run the full gates: `uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest` (all pass, including new tests) and in frontend `npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build`.
acceptance_criteria: The Forest Season Resort (property_id 'mus-forestseason') is the home property: HOME_PROPERTY_ID in analytics_dataset.py and sentinel_seed.py both resolve to it, and /market-radar/analytics/playbook returns home_property_name 'The Forest Season Resort'.

A generated, deterministic review dataset for the resort exists across all 5 platforms mixing en/hi/hi-Latn, dated across ~18 months, and is ingested through the real ReviewParser+enrich pipeline (visible in /market-radar/review-counts and /market-radar/properties/mus-forestseason/reviews).

data/sample_reviews/mussoorie_reviews.json and the COUNTS block in data/datasheet.md are regenerated and consistent (the count-match test passes), and the datasheet honesty note documents the dataset is synthetic/representative and that live scraping needs official platform APIs/permission.
A backend test ingests the generated resort file through POST /market-radar/collection/upload and asserts job status + new_count, proving the real collection path.
Sentinel board/metrics, Concierge facts, Guest Compass and Destination heatmap all return populated, sensible data referencing The Forest Season Resort.
All quality gates green: backend uv run ruff check . + uv run pytest (>=236, including new tests); frontend npm run lint + npx vitest run (>=14) + npm run build (21 routes).

In-process TestClient verification shows HTTP 200 with resort-populated data for /health, /market-radar/review-counts, /sentinel/board, /sentinel/metrics, /destination/heatmap, /concierge/facts, /market-radar/analytics/playbook.
verification: cd backend && uv run ruff check .
cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed

cd backend && uv run python - <<'PY'
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
c=TestClient(app)
for p in ['/health','/market-radar/review-counts','/sentinel/board','/sentinel/metrics','/destination/heatmap','/concierge/facts','/market-radar/analytics/playbook','/market-radar/analytics/what-if/Google']:
    r=c.get(p); print(p, r.status_code, str(r.json())[:160])
PY
cd frontend && npm run lint && npx vitest run && npm run build
findings: DONE. Baseline confirmed green first (backend 236 pytest + ruff clean; frontend lint clean, 14 vitest, build 21 routes). Added The Forest Season Resort (mus-forestseason / 'The Forest Season Resort') as the FIRST entry in PROPERTIES (sample_reviews.py), making it the cluster Home_Property. Built a deterministic seeded generator app/seed/forest_season_reviews.py (seed 20240915) producing 52 RawSeedReview records for the resort across ALL 5 platforms (Google 12, MakeMyTrip 10, Booking.com 9, TripAdvisor 11, Agoda 10), dated ~18 months (2023-01-10..2024-06-20), mixing en (20) / hi (20) / hi-Latn (12) with aspect-rich code-switched text; 10 records have has_source_url=False. These are spliced into build_raw_records() via _all_seed_reviews() so the REAL ReviewParser+enrich pipeline ingests them (visible in /market-radar/review-counts and the per-property reviews endpoint). DATASET TOTALS after regen (scripts/build_dataset.py): 82 total records (52 resort + 6 competitors x 5 = 30). Per platform: Google 18, MakeMyTrip 16, Booking.com 15, TripAdvisor 17, Agoda 16. Per language: en 35, hi 26, hi-Latn 21. Re-centered everything on the resort: HOME_PROPERTY_ID in analytics_dataset.py (propagates to changepoints/what_if/playbook/impact/briefing/intervention_store/guest_compass/analytics_service), added a +0.08 personality offset for the resort and kept the Food negative-trend/changepoint injection on HOME (now the resort) for BOCPD + Time Machine; LEADER stays mus-cloudvalley; time_machine _INTERVENTIONS re-anchored to mus-forestseason. sentinel_seed HOME_PROPERTY_ID/NAME -> resort. Concierge facts rewritten topical to the resort (breakfast/checkout/wifi/parking/location/spa + new pets fact replacing pool; updated _TOPIC_KEYWORDS and update_fact fallback). Destination Lens: relabeled 3 seed mentions (mall-1, kempty-3, landour-1) to the resort. Regenerated data/sample_reviews/mussoorie_reviews.json + datasheet COUNTS block, updated COLLECTION_DATE_RANGE to 2023-01-10..2024-06-30, and rewrote datasheet prose + honesty note (synthetic/representative, generated Home_Property, live scraping needs official platform APIs/permission). Added backend/tests/test_forest_season.py (10 tests): generator determinism, all-5-platform+multilingual coverage, review-counts/reviews populated, HOME_PROPERTY_ID==resort, analytics (playbook/what-if/changepoints/decomposition/time-machine) centred on resort, sentinel board/metrics populated, concierge facts topical, and a REAL upload-endpoint ingestion test (POST /market-radar/collection/upload posts the generated TripAdvisor resort rows, asserts status + new_count == rows, and a re-post dedupes to new_count 0). Fixed existing home-dependent tests (test_changepoints, test_time_machine, test_analytics_api decomposition cluster_size 6->7 + time-machine property, test_authenticity boosted property, test_market_model cluster_size 7 + property set, test_seed_startup reviews path, test_market_radar_api counts) and test_concierge (pool->pets). All gates GREEN: backend ruff clean + 246 pytest pass; frontend lint clean + 14 vitest + build 21 routes. In-process TestClient verification: /health, /market-radar/review-counts (resort leads, 52, all 5 platforms), /sentinel/board, /sentinel/metrics, /destination/heatmap, /concierge/facts, /market-radar/analytics/playbook (home_property_name 'The Forest Season Resort'), /market-radar/analytics/what-if/Google all HTTP 200 with resort-populated data. NOTE: get_market_radar_service() is a process-wide lru_cache singleton shared across TestClient apps, so the upload test mutates the shared store; made count assertions order-independent (>=) to stay robust. Did NOT implement real live scraping (no free credential-less path; violates platform terms) - honored the honest 'generate + real-pipeline' approach per the brief. OUT OF SCOPE for FEAT-001 (separate features/steerings): the auth/login page and any live-URL deployment.
